propositions: Changing ticket_type from bug to task (or vice versa) carries forward a stale plan-review verdict computed under different exemption criteria without re-running the review
The material_fingerprint used to gate reuse does not include ticket_type as a factor, so type changes do not invalidate stored attestations
Both idempotent_reuse (PASS path) and verdict_reuse (BLOCK path) reuse functions must compare stored ticket_type against current context type and return None (fail open) when they differ
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type, so no schema change is required; the fix reads the existing field for validation only
A fail-open approach preserves reuse for sidecars written before the type check or with empty type, avoiding mass invalidation of existing attestations
